summary: The automatic mode in force for a send's contact released the send without asking a person, a pass of its text by the critic or by a person standing, and the line names the approval that records the release, where the mode came from, whether the contact was cold or warm, and the review that released it.

key.description: The contact's temperature in the campaign, the mode of which released the send.

new.description: The release by its identifiers, never the subject, the preview or a text.

id.description: The approval written already approved, with the reason automatic_mode, decided by the person who set the mode in force.

subject_hash.description: The digest of what was released; the subject itself stays on the approval.

source.description: Where the mode in force came from: the installation's preference, or the campaign's own mode.

temperature.description: Whether the contact had answered in the campaign, the same as the key.

review.description: The workitem_reviewed line whose pass released the send: the critic's, or a person's.
